verdict.rationale: Mintlify ships an official CLI (mintlify-docs-11/29, confirmed by probe mintlify-probe-5) used to preview docs locally, test changes in real time, and catch build errors before deployment — a core dev/agentic workflow tool. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of CLI usage or evidence of AI-specific CLI subcommands tailored for agent workflows beyond standard doc preview.
